items.title: Merck (MRK) Stock Looks Fully Priced After A 127% Run
items.summary: Merck stock has delivered strong gains over the past few years, while the latest valuation checks send mixed signals as the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate suggests upside but traditional market multiples point the other way. The stock also carries a low broader value score, which leans more toward expensive than clear bargain territory.
